questions.q: From which city does Judith say Nebuchadnezzar reigned over the Assyrians?
questions.evidence: IN the twelfth year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, who reigned over the Assyrians in Nineveh, the great city

questions.q: Who was the chief captain of Nebuchadnezzar's army?
questions.evidence: And it came to pass, when he had ended his counsel, Nebuchadnezzar king of the Assyrians called Holofernes the chief captain of his host, which was next after himself, and said to him

questions.q: Which leader of the Ammonites told Holofernes the history of Israel?
questions.evidence: And Achior, the leader of all the children of Ammon

questions.q: Toward which city did Holofernes command his whole army to move its camp?
questions.evidence: that they should remove their camp toward Bethulia

questions.q: How long had Judith been a widow?
questions.evidence: And Judith was a widow in her house three years and four months

questions.q: How many times did Judith strike Holofernes' neck?
questions.evidence: And she struck twice upon his neck with all her might, and took away his head from him

questions.q: Where did Judith tell the people to hang the head of Holofernes?
options: On the battlement of the wall
On a tree by the spring
questions.evidence: And Judith said to them, Hear me now, my brethren, and take this head, and hang it upon the battlement of your wall

questions.q: How old was Judith when she died?
questions.evidence: and she waxed old in her husband’s house, to a hundred and five years, and let her maid go free: and she died in Bethulia
